methods.label: Represent expenditure with a sign
methods.explanation: Income is recorded as positive. Expenditure has the opposite meaning and should be recorded as negative. Its value is 150, so it is -150 yuan.
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 representation of income and expenditure as opposite quantities.
